sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Remove the standalone constraint that requires exactly one firstScheduledDryDockingDate for every pre-1 July 2007 triggered ship; the regulation requires the marking by that event, not a dry-docking-date record, and an already correctly marked ship must not fail merely because that date is absent. Restructure the pre-2007 logic so an unmarked ship may defer the marking only when a valid first scheduled dry-docking date after 1 July 2007 is evidenced and has not yet arrived; if the marking is already complete and equals the certificate maximum amidships draught, permit conformance without dry-docking-date evidence, while ensuring missing date evidence cannot make an unmarked ship pass accidentally.
